context:
Goal: two fixes to the guard rule that refuses a check piped into tail or head land, with no agent going around the guard to do it.
Problem (rule): the lane working on those fixes installed its guard before your ruling that a main merge with conflicts in both test files and product files goes to one test-author, so its guard lets no agent commit that merge on #2156 (the rule also reads a command that ends in a glued &); either that lane changes its own guard mid-run or a new lane does the work, and both need your word.
Based on (read): the coordinator says the lane's guard is older than that merge ruling, so it still refuses a test-author's edit to a product file.
Based on (read): for the merge on #2015 (the rule also refuses any filter after a lane check run), the lane's brief had a test-author copy product files with a shell command, which went around the guard's refusal of file edits.
Departs from: main (a lane runs on the guard it installed at start) — a) a fresh lane session finishes #2156 with #2015 on today's guard; b) the running lane re-installs its guard from main mid-run.
Meanwhile: the coordinator holds #2156 and #2015; other lanes go on.
home: coordinator lane plan (the lane for the tail and head rule); step bg-tail-loses-verdict

options.gain: The merge runs under today's guard from the first call, and the lane that went around the guard stops.
options.how: The coordinator starts one fresh lane session, which installs today's guard at start, and it finishes #2156 with #2015; the old lane ends.
options.label: Fresh lane session (Recommended)
options.lose: One more session starts during the freeze on new sessions, and the new lane re-reads the work.

options.gain: No new session starts, and the lane keeps what it knows.
options.how: The running lane re-installs its guard from main and then commits the merge.
options.label: Re-install the guard in the running lane
options.lose: A session changes its own guard mid-run, so its work runs under two rule sets.

reply: You picked a at 14:04 CST: a fresh lane session finishes #2156 with #2015 on today's guard, and the old lane ends. Triage sent your pick to the coordinator at 14:06 CST, and the coordinator starts that lane. (Triage, 14:06 CST.)
short: Tail rule lane: fresh session or re-install?
title: How should the two fixes #2156 and #2015 finish: in a fresh lane session, or after the running lane re-installs its guard?
why: A fresh session runs on today's guard from its first call, and nothing changes a guard mid-run.
